about.title: Between the past and the future
about.text:
I'm an Egyptian artist and graphic designer living in Dubai. I trained at the Faculty of Fine Arts, Alexandria University, and I have never stopped studying the Old Masters: how they built a face out of light, how a single line can carry weight and warmth.

I move between charcoal and paper, digital painting and the risograph, and I teach all three. Most of my work starts the same way, with a careful drawing and a question about where tradition meets the life we live now.

works.title: Between the Past and Future
works.story: A woman in a red kandora and gold-trimmed burqa reaches for an old lantern. Behind her, the Dubai skyline is drawn only in outline, as if it hasn't been finished yet. Made at Tashkeel in 2024.

works.title: Fairouz
works.medium: Risograph print, two colours. With Ibrahim Zaki
works.story: A portrait of the singer built from thousands of engraved lines in riso blue, overprinted with Ibrahim Zaki's red Arabic lettering. Shown in Khali Balak Men RISO at Tashkeel, 2026.

works.title: A Day in Dubai
works.medium: Risograph print, up to five colours
works.story: The Museum of the Future, Dubai Frame, Burj Al Arab and Burj Khalifa in one afternoon, with a skateboarder and a very curious cat. Each colour is a separate pass through the riso machine; the whole print took about two hours.

works.title: Galactic Adventure
works.story: An astronaut and two children look out of a plane window at a ship made of Arabic calligraphy. Designed as a sketchbook cover for the Tashkeel shop.

teaching.title: The workshop table
teaching.text: I've led drawing, portrait, pastel and risograph workshops at Tashkeel since 2022, for children, families and adults. The method is the same at every level: look longer, measure honestly, and let light and shadow do the work.
